## About
Engines Xtreme is an engine remanufacturer and machine shop at 523 E Church St in Lewisville. We do block preparation, grind crankshafts, resize connecting rods and remanufacture cylinder heads, short blocks and long blocks, along with a line of internal engine parts.
Every product we build is taken apart, cleaned and checked for defects, then machined to factory specifications. It goes back together with new pistons, rings, bearings, timing components, lifters, oil pumps and gaskets, along with reground camshafts.
Customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 32 Google reviews. Have a special order, a custom application or a performance question? Call or email us and we will talk it over.

## Services
- Block preparation: Getting your engine block ready for the build in our machine shop.
- Crankshaft grinding and connecting rod resizing: Crankshaft grinding and connecting rod resizing done in our machine shop.
- Cylinder head work: Cylinder head resurfacing, cleaning and valve jobs.
- Short blocks and long blocks: Remanufacturing of cylinder heads, short blocks, basic long blocks and premium long blocks.

## FAQ
Q: When can I reach you?
A: We take calls Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. We are closed Saturdays and Sundays.

Q: How much does a job cost?
A: Give us a call for pricing on your engine or machine work.

Q: Can you help with a special order or custom application?
A: Yes, call or email us with special orders, custom applications or performance questions.
